label: first copy step (input = first original token) in long sequences
explanation: Fires almost only at the step right after <DEL>, where the first original token is fed back and the model outputs original token 1 (recall_idx==1; this holds 99.9% of activation mass). Strongly modulated by sequence length: about 30% of L=9 sequences fire there (84% of mass), L=8 gives about 15% of mass, L=7 is rare, and L<=6 never fires. Within long sequences, magnitude and firing rate also depend on which token is fed back: n, y, 2, w, j, z, k, l are highest (the top activations are mostly n/y at L=9). Even at L=9 only about 60% of first-copy steps fire, so token identity accounts for the rest only in a graded way. Never fires in the original phase, on <DEL>, or at later copy steps.
